bio.text: Corey Jackson was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 to represent the 60th Assembly District and was reelected in November 2024. He chairs Budget Subcommittee No. 2 on Human Services.
He previously served on the Riverside County Board of Education and was the founder and chief executive officer of SBX Youth and Family Services.
He graduated from CSU San Bernardino with a degree in political science, and from California Baptist University with a Master of Social Work degree and a Doctor of Social Work degree.
